306:t_002:10.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I'm doing it to survive! You have no right to complain!」

306:t_002:11.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I heard we'd lost track of you around here. I thought you'd fled to $$ＥＸ－１０$$, and I was exactly right.」

306:t_002:12.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Now do you see my strategic insight, surpassing even $$ゼロ$$'s cunning!?」

306:t_002:13.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It seems that conceited man has outwitted us this once.」

306:t_002:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still, we're better off without that $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped lunatic and that thug in tacky gold plating.」

306:t_002:15.en:
$$スザク$$
「Since our opponent isn't $$サイデリアル$$, $$マーティアル$$ won't come out...! We have to fight on our own!」

306:t_002:17.en:
$$マオ$$
「And our machines are at best at 80% of peak condition. This is pretty rough.」

306:t_002:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But we have to do it. We'll finish them off and leave the jungle before their main force arrives.」

306:t_002:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We have six minutes for this operation! Any longer, and we risk a fatal situation!」

306:t_002:20.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Heh... Heh heh... I can just picture $$ゲイツ$$'s and $$ベック$$'s frustrated faces...」

306:t_002:21.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Here I come, $$キリコ$$! I don't need to wait for the main force! I'll settle things with you here!」

306:t_003:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You're tougher than I imagined. But it wouldn't be fun for me if you dropped dead so easily.」

306:t_003:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I owe you all plenty of payback.」

306:t_003:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Shut up, $$カレン$$! My downfall began when you people disobeyed my orders in $$クメン$$!」

306:t_003:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$! And $$シャッコ$$, $$カレン$$ and $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! I'll never forgive you four!」

306:t_003:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Then could you let the rest of us go?」

306:t_003:7.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Well, well, $$ロジャー・スミス$$. Like a true negotiator, you intend to talk your way out of this.」

306:t_003:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is my actual job, after all.」

306:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you say, Mr. $$カン・ユー$$? We can't afford to be wiped out here...」

306:t_003:10.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I see. So you're willing to overlook a few sacrifices.」

306:t_003:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We sacrifice the few to save the many... Four lives to save five. It's a simple arithmetic problem.」

306:t_003:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$! You intend to sell out your friends!?」

306:t_003:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You've disappointed me, $$ゼロ$$. I didn't think you'd let emotion blind you to efficiency.」

306:t_003:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「First, I'm ensuring my own safety. At the same time, protecting you as $c's strategist is my top priority.」

306:t_003:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「Y-you're lying! $$ロジャー$$ would never say something like that! It's a lie!!」

306:t_003:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You lousy negotiator! You silver-tongued con man! You force things through without any logic, you show-off crow bastard!」

306:t_003:18.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「They're being very harsh with you.」

306:t_003:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Say what you like. I'm simply doing my job to protect you.」

306:t_003:20.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「This is disgraceful, $c. You're fighting among yourselves at a time like this.」

306:t_003:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To be honest, I'm starting to lose patience with them, too. Perhaps I should consider a way for only myself to survive.」

306:t_003:22.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Are you planning to defect to our side?」

306:t_003:23.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you say? I'm confident I could be of some use.」

306:t_003:24.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Hahahahaha, you fool! You're sorely mistaken if you think I'd grant that request!」

306:t_004:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「So you did have reinforcements ready!」

306:t_004:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You're just as $$ベック$$ said, you lousy negotiator! Tell me why you bothered with such pointless negotiations!」

306:t_004:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...That was no negotiation at all.」

306:t_004:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I was just buying time.」

306:t_004:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Are you sure about this, $$カン・ユー$$? Your trump card is already on its last legs.」

306:t_005:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I've confirmed enemy machines! They can't react to us!」

306:t_006:2.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and I are both safe!」

306:t_006:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're late, $n! We had to put on that lousy act to delay their reinforcements!」

306:t_006:5.en:
$$スザク$$
「It's all right. You made it in time.」

306:t_006:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm hurt that you call it a lousy act, $$マオ$$. Isn't that insulting to me, after I endured my friends' cruel words to play the villain?」

306:t_006:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「Sorry, sorry. Your performance was excellent, Mr. Negotiator.」

306:t_006:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'd like some praise for our supporting performances, too.」

306:t_006:10.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Of course, it was all an act.」

306:t_006:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You're a cowardly bastard. Of course we knew you'd have reinforcements ready.」

306:t_006:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$n contacted us to say he'd join us soon. We were timing things so he could act as our trump card.」

306:t_006:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though one person took the opportunity to hurl a barrage of abuse at me...」

306:t_006:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
「H-hey, $n! How was your week alone with Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

306:t_006:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly, $n! Think about whether this is the time for jokes.」

306:t_006:21.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「That's enough of your reunion greetings.」

306:t_006:24.en:
$$カレン$$
「We've both shown our whole hands! Now we fight head-on!」

306:t_007:0.en:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$ has taken considerable damage. I'll move to support $$ロジャー$$.」

306:t_007:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I understand. It seems you've had a rough time, too.」

306:t_007:2.en:
$n
「Still, if it means I get to see you all again like this...」

306:t_007:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's a sweet thing to say!」

306:t_007:4.en:
$n
「It's a bit strange hearing that from you, $$カレン$$...」

306:t_007:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「I take it back! Work hard to make up for being late!」
